description.p: A from-scratch reimplementation of the Wolfenstein 3D engine built with the Bevy game engine. It renders the original WL6 maps, wall textures, sprites and digitised sounds through a software raycaster.

No game data is bundled. You must supply your own legally obtained copy of the registered Wolfenstein 3D (WL6) files and point the app at them in its configuration file. See the project README for details.

Fix enemy damage: shots used the full 32-bit random value, so a single hit could kill the player instantly. Damage now uses the original's 0-255 values, and the player's own weapon damage matches the original as well.

First stable release. The enemy AI now follows the original's tile-based chase/dodge, per-enemy speeds, probabilistic shooting and dog bite; sight and noise propagate through floor areas, and ambush actors only wake when they see the player. Adds a persistent high-score table, a single save slot (menu or F5/F9), the death cam, and the "Get Psyched!" intro. Also fixes ambush spawn tiles, which were treated as solid walls.

Major gameplay update: pushable secret walls, secret floors with routing, an end-of-floor intermission with kill/secret/treasure ratios, in-game difficulty selection, and a game-over screen. Enemies now open doors and alert each other, and bosses and ghosts render with the correct sprites.
Fix the level ending by itself: pressing USE on door number 21 was mistaken for the elevator switch. The switch is now matched on the raw tile, so doors only open.
Fix a door-frame edge that disappeared when a door was seen at a shallow angle: the door panel was drawn over the frame on one side.
Fix doors: the inner door frame no longer disappears on one side, and a closing door no longer traps the player.
Fix the player's weapon floating in the middle of the view: it is now scaled to the full view height and rests on the bottom edge, matching the original.
